description: Restyle text with Unicode look-alike characters for bios and posts (28 styles): Bold, Italic, Bold italic, Script, Bold script, Fraktur, Bold fraktur, Double-struck, Sans-serif, Sans bold, Sans italic, Sans bold italic, Monospace, Circled, Circled dark, Squared, Squared dark, Parenthesized, Fullwidth, Small caps, Superscript, Upside down, Strikethrough, Underline, Double underline, Slashed, Overline, Wide spaced. Only Latin letters and digits change (other scripts such as Arabic and emoji pass through); some styles cover only capitals or only some symbols. Give one "style", or none to get every style. Up to 20,000 characters. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/fancy-text/

style.description: One style name (exact, e.g. "Bold", "Script", "Upside down"). Omit to get all styles.
